column4: No degree bound or uniformity of C is fixed; arbitrary-degree scalar polynomials already give arbitrarily large finite scalar fibers. Improving the k-asymptotics requires fixed-degree hypotheses and free-entropy definitions from the source.
For every n>0 and primitive class, the series F and conventions are external; genus-one GW/PT wall crossing needs a full virtual-class comparison, not a coefficient instance.

Omega, boundary conditions, admissible density class, positivity and time dependence of K are unspecified. Constant positive definite K reduces to a classical metric and gives no full general classification.

All gentle algebras of the stated surface type are requested, including genus-dependent winding/Arf data. Theorem3.3 and the specified winding conventions are absent; reconstructing a small quiver is insufficient.
Q and orbit-finiteness assumptions are absent; not every quiver has finitely many representation orbits. Need the source category before multiplicity computation; no domain-correction credit.
All d>=3, finite S and q are quantified. Greedy disjoint Caratheodory simplices only yields a weaker denominator; achieving d-1 needs a structural packing argument, not a small witness search.
Requires asymptotically tight bounds uniformly over n,k and general-position arrangements in dimension d. Enumerating one arrangement or repairing the k=0 endpoint does not close the exponent gap.
All d and fields are requested; d=1 gives s=0, so intended nontrivial domain must be restored. Pair-incidence counting gives constraints but not realizability/minimizers for every d.
Despite corrupted point-sum typography, the ideal formula specifies reduced complex point sets and all degrees/multiplicities. A single unexpected configuration cannot classify every configuration.

The positivity condition is explicit but covering-family and J quantifiers need source clarification. A projective algebraic criterion or one compatible J does not settle arbitrary symplectic manifolds.

Already reports nonuniqueness, rather than posing an unanswered assertion. f and regularity quantifiers are not fixed. Choosing f to be a nodal eigenfunction is an elementary separation-of-variables example and yields no credit.

Explicitly announces an existing counterexample with uncountably many solutions for a single continuous lambda of every p>2 variation. Rough integration/enhancement and solution conventions are external; reproducing it is not new.

As m varies, superpolynomial homogeneous trace complexity is a major lower-bound problem. Field and orbit-embedding conventions are external; fixed-m calculations cannot imply the asymptotic lower bound.
Three-way compactness equivalence is presented as a result, with bounded intrinsic geometry undefined and q-range implicit. No evidence that formalizing this report theorem is new research.

All finite matrix groups and promised w in the orbit are quantified, but efficient and word encoding/length are not fixed. Gaussian elimination constructs a matrix in GL, not a short word in arbitrary supplied generators.

The minimization is over colored graphs extending Omega with the exact induced group action. Encoding all group elements gives a finite upper construction, not the minimum size for every permutation group.

The representation rho and transfer gamma are only specified by reference. Character summation already defines a kernel; explicit uniform evaluation plus an involutive extension is a different substantial obligation.

General perturbations outside subcriticality are requested; Einstein-matter system, admissible exponents and behavior criterion are external. The displayed failure inequality alone cannot define a proof target.

Full exponent range and alpha-scaling without normal transversality are requested. Tangential wave packets are a possible obstruction mechanism, but no sharp all-parameter construction or classification is available here.
Record already asserts LNE as a positive answer; Gamma_pi,L_pi,P_pi and allowed resolutions are external. Merely supplying the LNE example cannot be a new outcome.

All n and mixtures are intended, but component subsets, allowed states and spin dimension need primary definitions. One-spin concavity only handles an instance and cannot control overlapping entangled components.
Matrix dimension and quantum input/access model are not specified. The two recorded lower bounds do not multiply to the upper bound; ordinary sampling is not a matching oracle-model result.

The optimization functional is explicit but determine/analyze gives no theorem endpoint or domain/alpha assumptions. Finite-dimensional representer reductions do not by themselves settle an identified new conjecture.
Already labelled Theorem11; consistency and duplicable separation are quoted external definitions. Recovering its exponent from those definitions would reproduce the source theorem.
No specified common-information functional, exact joint-distribution class or link identity is given. A familiar data-processing inequality is a routine connection, not a full target resolution.
All q,a,b are intended, but reconstruction success means weak versus exact recovery and limiting criterion need definition. Kesten-Stigum or fixed-q cases cannot determine the general boundary.
Already asserts a precise change-of-variables formula for all stated stacks and cylinders; motivic measure and height conventions are external. No new proof claim from a scheme special case.

Record already states both rational stable certificates and strongly infeasible SDP exceptions. Cone input representation and stability convention are missing; a rational example would duplicate a reported result.

No precise observation model, sampling rate or factorization algorithm is fixed. Replacing quadratic conditioning by a new sharp bound requires those hypotheses; empirical insensitivity is not a theorem.
Every fixed compact G is intended, with measure/quotient and renormalization external. Abelian Gaussian construction does not settle the nonabelian three-dimensional construction.

Both infima over all finite groups are required; theta-prime has an empty minimizing class family for abelian groups unless a convention is restored. Small character tables cannot prove universal half bounds.

Sufficient conditions for all affine ranks/weights are requested, beyond necessary gcd1. Atomic length uses an external coroot convention; checking a few e is neither a universal criterion nor new credit.
For every smooth projective Cp variety the whole essential image is requested. The version of the p-adic Simpson functor is external; trivial bundles or curves do not settle the full category.
All s in (1/2,1) and k>=1 are quantified with an explicit Rayleigh quotient. Domain scaling cancels, but determining sharp constants requires extremal geometry, not a test-domain upper bound.

Primary p3294 states equal cardinalities as Theorem1 and asks for a bijection. Endpoint/axis convention matters at the origin; lexicographic matching would merely use the stated theorem and give no substantive credit. No natural full-multiset mechanism established.

Primary pp3297-3298 gives characteristic polynomials already. The displayed hyperplane indices need i<j convention; sign-vector encoding is tautological, whereas requested parking/tree-style combinatorics needs a uniform new map.

For each finite triangulation and r,m, matching edge-jet coefficients gives a finite rational/real constraint matrix and dimension equals variables minus rank. This tautological linear-algebra algorithm does not supply the requested structural geometric dimension formula.

Every prime p and dimension n are requested, with affine covers and spanning normals. Exhaustive enumeration gives fixed instances only; irredundant spanning constraints prevent simply using parallel p-hyperplane covers.

Already asserts a deterministic approximation theorem with absolute gamma for all graphs and epsilon. Repeating a zero-free-polynomial interpolation method would reproduce the stated result, not a new conjecture resolution.
All BN-admissible d,g,r and dominance of evaluation are requested. Dimension count supplies a necessary upper bound only; exceptional curves and the precise BN component definitions require bodies.
Despite corrupted sphere typography the extremal measurable-set claim is clear. All dimensions are intended; planar arcs or finite spherical codes cannot prove the sharp surface-measure extremum.
Already asserts braid behavior and a limsup result, with E_b,L and well-separation conditions external. Diagonalizing a three-by-three tunneling model does not justify its continuum error estimates.

All pointed stable positive-characteristic curves are intended. Admissible group, allowed maps and reconstruction functor are external; a special dual graph does not settle group-theoretical degeneration.
Initial-data integrability, vacuum and admissible weak-solution class are absent. Classical smooth data or convex-integration examples do not provide general global finite-energy existence.

Needs a graph family with the explicit linear vertex-cover gap and unbounded SA refutation degree, beyond CFI variants. CNF/SA conventions are external; a cover gap alone has no degree lower-bound certificate.

Primary pp2694-2696 states Theorems1-3 and sketches fixed-point/Riesz proofs, explicitly citing Tao-Thiele2012 Theorem7 for existence. Definitions L,H,H0* are external to the literal record. No new inverse theorem claimed; dependency chain not fully audited.

Primary pp2686-2687 proves recursive QSP synthesis and pp2717-2720 lists phase-finding methods. Literal displayed matrix lacks the usual minus on the conjugate off-diagonal; n1 at x0 is incompatible with any phases. This is a wording defect, not a discovery; no full endpoint-stability audit claimed.

Brownian derivative is not an L2 initial control; rough extension and controllability hypotheses need definition. Constant spanning fields yield an elementary solvable instance only; no rough full-scope convergence theorem.

Primary p2992 confirms bounded edge-congestion question. Each edge-variable participates in <=k path constraints, suggesting generic column-sparse packing approximations, but that is a routine adaptation and no sharp tree-specific full route is established.

Primary p2993 defines lightness and asks exactly two-color search/decision. Acyclic-neighborhood tests are polynomial but do not produce a global two-color partition; five-color algorithms quoted there do not bridge the gap.
